top_signals.title: Commission invests €3.4 billion in net-zero technology projects
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 19 Oct 2026 Today, the European Commission has selected 77 European net-zero technology projects to receive funding support worth €3.4 billion under the second call of the Innovation Fund, launched in December 2025.

top_signals.title: EU invests over €390 million in 135 new climate and environment projects
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 19 Oct 2026 The European Commission has today granted more than €390 million to 135 new projects across Europe under the LIFE programme for environment and climate action.

top_signals.title: Commission sends Statement of Objections to KKR for providing incorrect or misleading information during merger investigation
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 19 Oct 2026 The European Commission has informed KKR & Co. Inc. ('KKR') of its preliminary view that the company provided incorrect and/or misleading information during the 2024 Commission's investigation of KKR's acquisition of NetCo, under the EU Merger Regulation ('EUMR').
